messages.text: Hey, I bought the monitor stand in three credit-card instalments. I returned it already. Will the instalments complicate my refund?

messages.text:
The three instalments shouldn’t complicate it: the policy treats instalments of one payment as a single payment record, so a refund can go back to that original payment method (refund-policy/v2/payment). Your order records show the monitor stand was received back and hasn’t been refunded (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/remaining).

Would you like me to request the refund for it?
